reason: I'd play with the free tricks, but I'm not typing my card into a site I've never heard of, for an app that isn't even in the App Store, with no real performance videos or magician I can check behind it. I've bought magic apps before and I know which ones are legit; this one I can't vouch for yet.
objection: Who is behind this? No reviews I can find, no store listing, and paying by card on an unknown website. Also a browser-installed app doing a 'search on their own phone' reveal sounds too good, and I want to see it fooling real people on video first.
would_change_my_mind: Real unedited videos of the tricks working on spectators, plus reviews from Israeli magicians I recognise, and a trusted payment option like Bit, PayPal or Apple/Google Pay with a refund if it doesn't work on my phone.
